remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600)

add_driver_inf(hdaudbus hdaudbus.inf)

# hdaudbus.sys is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/hdaudbus-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(hdaudbus_shims OBJECT hdaudbus.cpp fdo.cpp pdo.cpp businterface.cpp)
target_link_libraries(hdaudbus_shims PRIVATE libcntpr libntoskrnl libhal)
add_cargo_module(hdaudbus hdaudbus-cargo hdaudbus.sys
    KIND kernelmodedriver
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/drivers
    EXTRA_DEPENDS hdaudbus_shims asm psdk)
